title: Mega Man X5
subtitle: PlayStation / original game · X + Zero
intro: Follow the route as either hunter, with X collecting the hearts. Complete Falcon and Gaea, then check the character, DNA and colony decisions before proceeding. Original English boss names appear beneath the modern names.
completionText: 8 hearts assigned as planned · 2 Sub Tanks · Weapon Tank · EX Tank · complete Falcon and Gaea. Optional: up to 8 chosen DNA parts; Ultimate Armor and Black Zero if Zero survives. Refill before Sigma.

warning.label: Permanent choices · read before New Game
warning.title: Start as X. Decide about DNA parts before boss 1.
warning.text: Starting as Zero removes Fourth Armor for the entire run. Heart Tanks belong only to the hunter who picks them up. DNA choices cannot be undone, and bosses defeated below level 8 do not award an equipable part. If the colony mission fails, Zero becomes unavailable; even all four shuttle components do not guarantee success. Keep a separate save before the final shuttle-component boss.
warning.linkText: Read the parts and colony decisions

routeIntro: Recommended: Normal difficulty, choose X in the opening, and keep X for heart collection. You can switch hunters at stage select. Both plans collect the same 20 stage pickups; the second also plans all eight possible DNA rewards. No cheats or glitches are required.

routes.name: Standard · armor and every pickup
routes.subtitle: Recommended first run
routes.description: Group return visits to conserve time. Early DNA rewards may be missed; every stage pickup remains obtainable.

steps.title: Start X → bosses 01–04
steps.text: Use Fourth Armor. Get the three reachable Falcon programs and Grizzly’s Sub Tank. Tidal Whale’s body program needs a return. Fight Dynamo when he interrupts.

steps.title: After 04: finish Falcon
steps.text: Let the Enigma event resolve. Revisit Whale as Fourth Armor X, use charged Goo Shaver on the capsule barrier, then Exit. Equip the complete Falcon at stage select.

steps.title: Bosses 05–08 with Falcon
steps.text: Collect all four Gaea programs, the Pegasus heart and Weapon Tank and Necrobat’s heart/tank. Get Dinorex’s heart between lava waves. Dynamo may interrupt after boss 6.

steps.title: Save before the last shuttle component
steps.text: If Enigma failed, keep a spare save before boss 8. The automatic shuttle event can remove Zero despite collecting every component.

steps.title: After the colony event: cleanup
steps.text: Use Gaea for the spike and V-block hearts. Firefly’s EX Tank is a separate Ground Fire visit because Gaea cannot use special weapons.

steps.title: Zero Space + secret capsule
steps.text: Get Ultimate Armor with unarmored X. If Zero is available, visit the same capsule with him before clearing Zero Space 3 to obtain Black Zero.

routes.name: Completionist · eight chosen DNA parts
routes.subtitle: Normal / Xtreme · tighter clock
routes.description: At most one of each boss’s two parts can be earned. All 16 are impossible in one save. This plan uses Zero for the first boss, then returns to X.

steps.title: Start as X; prepare without boss kills
steps.text: Spend five stage entries as X, returning to stage select after Game Over. Use them to practice Kraken’s bike and collect Grizzly’s tank/Falcon program. Stop at 11 hours on the map; do not lower Zero’s starting SA rank.

steps.title: 11h on map: Grizzly as Zero
steps.text: Entering leaves 10h. With Zero’s initial SA rank this boss is level 8+. Verify the level and choose a + reward. Return to X for Whale and permanent hearts.

steps.title: Whale → Dynamo → Kraken → Firefly
steps.text: Use Fourth Armor X; collect the Falcon programs and check the DNA table after each Maverick. Continue within a stage after deaths rather than spending another entry.

steps.title: Enigma → one Whale return
steps.text: If the colony remains, Enigma adds one hour; use the planned return to complete Falcon. Avoid extra shopping trips until the colony event is settled.

steps.title: Necrobat → Pegasus → Dynamo → Dinorex → Rosered
steps.text: Use Falcon X. Collect the four Gaea programs; save separately before the last shuttle-component boss. Each Maverick must be level 8+ for a part.

steps.title: Cleanup, finish development, then fortress
steps.text: After the colony event, complete return trips as X. Parts mature two stage completions/exits after selection; ensure the last rewards are ready and equipped before Sigma.

flowSubtitle: X weapon chain · Zero table below
flowIntro: Crescent Grizzly starts with the Buster. Pause after Firefly to finish Falcon before boss 5. Dark Hold freezes Pegasus but does not damage him: follow with Buster shots. Select a boss number in its stage header to return here.
basicsHtml:
Controls, pickups, armor and the clock
  • Choose X or Zero at stage select; a boss clear grants both hunters’ weapon/technique. Hearts belong only to the collector. Tanks and armor-program progress are shared.
  • Collecting a Falcon or Gaea program does not equip it. Find all four programs, then select the completed suit before entering a stage.
  • Fourth Armor can air-dash, hover and charge special weapons. Falcon can fly (Jump again in midair), but cannot charge special weapons. Gaea can cross spikes and break/push V-blocks, but cannot use special weapons or equip DNA parts.
  • Each new stage entry normally costs an hour; Dynamo battles also use time. On Game Over, Continue stays in the stage; returning to stage select and re-entering spends another hour. Pause → Exit works on cleared stages.
  • Save after progress. A permanent pickup survives death, but end the session using the game’s save system. The EX Tank changes starting lives; it is not health storage.
  • Zero’s weaknesses and technique inputs · Refill and movement tips

checkpoints.title: AFTER 04 · Finish Falcon before continuing
checkpoints.text: Revisit Tidal Whale as Fourth Armor X. The body program needs Goo Shaver; no suit works until all four programs are collected.
checkpoints.stageText: Complete the planned Whale return, then choose Falcon at stage select for bosses 05–08.

checkpoints.title: BEFORE 08 · Preserve a pre-launch save
checkpoints.text: If the colony is still present, Rosered supplies the final shuttle component and triggers the launch. A full set can still fail and remove Zero.
checkpoints.stageText: Save in a separate slot before Rosered if you want to retain a route where Zero remains available.

stages.name: Crescent Grizzly
stages.now: Grizzly Slash · Falcon Legs + Sub Tank; return for Heart
stages.tip: Crouch in the low ground under his crescents. Fire charged shots between jumps; move when he drills underground. Use Spike Ball in the rematch.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: At the front of the second truck already counting down to an explosion, drop below its nose to the tank. Grab it and jump right immediately; do not wait for the truck to explode.
items.when: First visit

media.alt: Sub Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Falcon · Leg Program
items.text: At the start of the cave after the trucks, stop under the first ceiling opening. Jump toward the right wall of the shaft, climb up and enter the capsule.
items.when: First visit · program 1/4; not usable alone

media.alt: Falcon · Leg Program location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Inside the large intact truck, climb the gap between its carriages to the roof. With Gaea equipped, cross the roof spikes to the heart.
items.when: After all four Gaea programs

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

stages.name: Tidal Whale
stages.now: Duff McWhalen · Return for both pickups
stages.tip: Crescent Shot clears his ice blocks as it hits. Keep away from the spike wall; jump off moving ice before it carries you into the spikes.

items.name: Falcon · Body Program
items.text: Replay after defeating Whale. Near the end of the sunken ship, stop beside the capsule behind the wall. Fully charge Goo Shaver and release it so the ice reaches the small explosive behind the barrier. Enter the opened passage.
items.when: After boss 04 · complete Falcon before boss 05
items.extra: Started as Zero? Unarmored X can send uncharged Goo Shaver along the floor to the explosive; Fourth Armor is the simpler route shown.

media.alt: Falcon · Body Program location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the sunken ship, reach the spike-lined vertical drop. Climb the spike wall with Gaea into the ceiling opening, then follow the upper passage back through the wreck to the heart.
items.when: After Gaea · separate from the earlier Falcon visit
items.extra: Zero alternative: use E-Blade on the cracked ceiling block in the wreck, then cross using F-Splasher. The heart goes to Zero if he collects it.

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

sprite.credit: Anonymous Waddle Dee / MMKB; game imagery © Capcom

stages.name: Volt Kraken
stages.now: Squid Adler · Falcon Head; return for Heart
stages.tip: Hit him with Goo Shaver, then move away from his response. Climb when the floor electrifies and avoid lingering near the central electric block.

items.name: Falcon · Head Program
items.need: All 8 blue Ride Chaser orbs in one attempt
items.text: Collect every blue orb in the opening bike section. The full set opens the barrier at the finish; enter the capsule before dropping into the facility. Missing even one leaves it closed.
items.when: First visit · retry the bike before continuing
items.extra: If the wall stays shut, retry from the bike checkpoint. Do not treat merely reaching the end as collecting the program.

media.alt: Falcon · Head Program location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Before the final pair of electric locks, open the separate upper shutter. Break the lower two V-blocks in the stack, then push the remaining block right by dashing into it. Use the block to reach and shoot the next lock; pass through to the heart.
items.when: After Gaea · keep one block as a step

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

stages.name: Shining Firefly
stages.now: Izzy Glow · Falcon Arms; return for Heart + EX
stages.tip: Fire Tri-Thunder as he appears; its wall sparks can reach him overhead. Move out of the large laser’s lane and avoid chasing his teleport directly.

items.name: Falcon · Arm Program
items.text: After the rotating tower and miniboss, watch above the purple barriers in the cannon section. Climb the right wall into the ceiling opening. Destroy the cannon blocking the upper passage with Crescent Shot, then enter the capsule.
items.when: First visit · then return to Whale

media.alt: Falcon · Arm Program location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Shoot down the opening drawbridge, then drop into the pit under it as Gaea X. Walk across the spikes to the right and collect the heart.
items.when: Gaea visit · EX Tank needs a different loadout

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

items.name: EX Tank
items.need: X with Ground Fire; not Gaea
items.text: Beyond the first moving spike chandeliers, find the item above the wooden ceiling. Burn the wood with Ground Fire, then jump up into the recess. Use Fourth or Falcon Armor so the weapon is available.
items.when: After Dinorex · separate visit from the Gaea heart
items.extra: Adds starting lives. Gaea cannot fire Ground Fire, so it cannot complete the shown method on the same visit.

media.alt: EX Tank location — full game scene

stages.name: Dark Necrobat
stages.now: Dark Dizzy · Heart + Sub Tank + Gaea Head
stages.tip: Steer Flash Laser into him from a safe distance. Destroy his small bats with Buster shots; keep clear before he freezes time and tries to grab you.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: At the end of the opening space-platform ride, spot the tank on the high ledge. Fly up from the moving platform to collect it before entering the gravity corridor.
items.when: First visit with Falcon
items.extra: Zero can double-jump here after Grizzly; Fourth Armor can also reach it with a carefully timed hover.

media.alt: Sub Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the gravity-switch corridor, reverse the room again at the fourth switch if the blocks hide the upper route. Continue with the heart’s ledge exposed, then fly onto it.
items.when: First visit with Falcon · collect as X

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Gaea · Head Program
items.text: Drop into the shaft immediately before the boss doors. Stand outside the barrier and fire an uncharged Flash Laser. Steer it through the narrow bends and around to the switch on the far side; destroy it to open the capsule room.
items.when: First visit · Gaea program 1/4
items.extra: The missile must approach from inside the maze. Refill weapon energy or restart the attempt if it hits a wall.

media.alt: Gaea · Head Program location — full game scene

stages.name: Spiral Pegasus
stages.now: The Skiver · Heart + Weapon Tank + Gaea Body
stages.tip: Stay near the center of the wing. Dark Hold stops him; use Buster shots for damage. Jump his horizontal rushes and avoid taking knockback near either edge.

items.name: Weapon Tank
items.text: On the large descending lift, go below it as it breaks through the floors. Take the tank from the lower central ledge before the lift crushes that platform.
items.when: First visit · do not ride past it

media.alt: Weapon Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: On the later large rising lift, enter the second sizable opening on the right. Destroy the time bomb, then follow the side corridor to its far corner for the heart.
items.when: First visit

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Gaea · Body Program
items.text: At the open-air diagonal lift, do not ride it away. Fly straight upward from its starting area to the high ledge holding the capsule.
items.when: First visit with Falcon · Gaea program 2/4

media.alt: Gaea · Body Program location — full game scene

stages.name: Burn Dinorex
stages.tip: Get within Wing Spiral’s reach after he lands, then retreat. Dash under his jumps and climb away from the rolling charge; avoid being trapped against a wall.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the first section swept by lava, wait beside the floor opening until a wave has passed. Drop, head left and descend the far shaft. Grab the heart on the right, then climb back out before the next wave.
items.when: First visit · a death does not undo the heart

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

items.name: Gaea · Arm Program
items.text: Near the boss entrance, the capsule sits low on the far right above the lava. Fly to that lower-right ledge instead of climbing directly to the boss doors.
items.when: First visit with Falcon · Gaea program 3/4
items.extra: Alternative: take the Ride Armor through the lower lava branch, then jump and eject onto the capsule ledge. X himself is not lava-proof.

media.alt: Gaea · Arm Program location — full game scene

stages.name: Spike Rosered
stages.now: Axle the Red · Gaea Legs; return for Heart
stages.tip: Use Ground Fire when the real Rosered lands. Move away from his vines and keep space to jump the bouncing spike ball; only the real body takes damage.

items.name: Gaea · Leg Program
items.text: In the second rope section over a bottomless gap, find the ceiling opening near the rope’s right end. Fly upward through it, avoiding the side spikes, to the capsule.
items.when: First visit · complete Gaea at stage select

media.alt: Gaea · Leg Program location — full game scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: At the first climb up the vines, break the V-block at ground level and follow the side passage right. Push the upper block into the floor gap to make a bridge. Clear the lower blocks, keeping one as a step; push it to the far edge and dash-jump from it to the heart ledge.
items.when: After Gaea · do not destroy every block

media.alt: Heart Tank location — full game scene

returns.title: Two visits: Falcon Body after 04; Heart after Gaea
Gaea · keep a V-block to reach the lock
Gaea for Heart; Fourth/Falcon + Ground Fire for EX

returnIntro: One disclosure per level, with the original pickup cards. Do Whale’s Falcon Body visit immediately after boss 04. Save all other cleanup until the colony event is resolved. Firefly requires two loadouts; Exit between them. These return methods put the remaining hearts on X.
extraSections:
DNA parts · choose before each boss

Missable: use Normal or Xtreme. Each of the eight Mavericks must be at least level 8 when defeated to offer an equipable part. Look for Life+ or Energy+ on the reward screen. A rematch cannot repair a missed choice.

Life/Energy without the extra + still develops a health/weapon-capacity upgrade. That upgrade goes to the hunter who completes the following stage, not necessarily the one who beat the boss. Keep X active afterward if building X’s health. The equipable part takes two later stage completions/exits; check the development screen before assuming it is ready.

Choose one per row. The recommendation column is for an X-focused run; Zero alternatives are marked. Equip finished parts in Player Setup: unarmored X/Zero have four slots; Fourth/Falcon/Ultimate have two; Gaea has none.

BossLife+Energy+X-focused choice
GrizzlyShock Buffer · less damage/knockbackHyper Dash · longer, faster dashEnergy+ · movement
WhaleSuper Recover · stronger refill pickupsW-Energy Saver · less weapon consumptionLife+ · refill convenience
KrakenQuick Charge · XZ-Saber Extend · ZeroLife+
FireflyBurst Shots · XShot Eraser · ZeroLife+
NecrobatAnti-Virus Guard · slower infectionVirus Buster · destroy virus dronesEnergy+

DinorexSpeed Shot · faster Buster projectilesBuster Plus · stronger BusterEnergy+
RoseredUltimate Buster · automatic charged shotsZ-Saber Plus · ZeroLife+
Parts route: clock and retry rules

Use X for the five preparation entries so Zero keeps his initial SA rank. At 11 hours on stage select, enter Grizzly as Zero: the clock becomes 10 and his rank raises the boss above the part threshold. Then switch to X for Whale and keep following the normal order. If you already changed Zero’s rank, check the boss’s displayed level instead of relying on the clock alone.

Only the single Whale return is planned before the colony event. If a bike attempt fails, use Continue within the stage. Repeated map exits spend the remaining margin. If the timer is nearly gone, prioritize the remaining shuttle-component bosses and collect missed armor afterward; you can still revisit all Maverick stages once the colony event ends.

Part names vary slightly by version. Black Zero already includes Shock Buffer, Shot Eraser and Virus Buster effects; do not spend his slots duplicating them.

Colony, Zero and endings

All components does not mean guaranteed success. The Enigma and shuttle outcomes involve chance. Losing the colony mission or letting the deadline expire can awaken Zero and remove him from character select. His Black Armor and playable ending then become unavailable in that run.

  1. Collect the four left-side bosses’ Enigma components. After the cannon fires, a successful result opens Zero Space early; still clear the remaining Mavericks for their pickups and weapons.
  2. If the cannon fails, collect all four right-side shuttle components. Keep a separate save before the last one; the launch follows automatically. Avoid deliberately infecting Zero.
  3. After the outcome, the urgent collection deadline is over. Do the return trips. If Zero is gone, continue as X; ordinary stage pickups and both X armor suits are still available.
  4. If Zero survives, save before the final stage and finish with either X or Zero for that character’s ending. If he awakens, only X’s altered ending is available. This guide does not use RNG manipulation or save-state tricks to force an outcome.

Ultimate Armor & Black Zero

Location: Zero Space 3, before the confrontation. No New Game code is needed. Zero must still be selectable to obtain Black Zero; in X5 this is a real power upgrade, unlike X4’s cosmetic black palette.

  1. Enter as unarmored X to reveal his capsule, or as Zero for Black Zero. Fourth, Falcon and Gaea X will not reveal Ultimate Armor. Jumper/Hyper Dash can help unarmored X through the spikes.
  2. After the spike section, look for the narrow pit under a stationary floating platform before the final long platform gauntlet. Slide down its right wall into the hidden alcove.
  3. Touch the capsule. Zero changes immediately; X must return to stage select to equip Ultimate Armor.
  4. To get both on one save, do not clear the confrontation yet. After the first capsule visit, lose the remaining lives and choose the option to return to stage select, rather than continuing at the checkpoint. Enter again with the other hunter, collect their upgrade, then finish the stage.

Ultimate Armor gives repeatable Nova Strike. Black Zero improves defense and saber damage and includes three part effects. These are intended capsule rewards.

⤢

Playing as Zero

You can keep the X opening and still play Zero afterward; only his Z-Buster is lost. The main pickup route gives the hearts to X. For a Zero-focused run, assign reachable hearts and developed Life upgrades to him deliberately—there is one copy of each heart, not one per hunter. Zero can collect armor programs for X, but cannot wear Falcon or Gaea.

BossUse as ZeroTechnique earned / input
GrizzlySaber first; Twin Dream in rematchC-Sword: Jump again for double-jump; Attack in air for spin
WhaleC-Sword · jump-slashF-Splasher: Dash in midair
KrakenF-Splasher · air-dash into openingE-Blade: Up + Attack on ground
FireflyE-Blade · rise beside himC-Flasher: Giga Attack on ground
NecrobatC-Flasher; finish with saber if emptyDark Hold: select, then activate with Attack
PegasusDark Hold, then saberW-Shredder: Attack during a ground dash
DinorexW-ShredderQuake Blazer: Down + Attack while falling
RoseredQuake BlazerTwin Dream: select, then activate with Attack

C-Flasher, Dark Hold and Twin Dream consume weapon energy. Other listed techniques do not. Use your mapped action buttons, not assumed controller labels.

For ordinary Zero collection, get Necrobat/Pegasus/Dinorex hearts with his movement skills; Whale also has the E-Blade ceiling route described in its card. The Gaea V-block paths require X. Avoid assigning most upgrades to Zero without retaining a save before the colony outcome.

Useful tips

Refill at the Planetarium

After the colony event, revisit Dark Necrobat with Falcon Armor. Fly through the bats in the opening area, gather their health drops, then move away and return to repeat. Super Recover improves refill pickups if you earned and equipped it. Check both tank gauges, then Exit the cleared stage.

Use the right suit for the task

Falcon flight protects against enemy contact, but is not permission to touch spikes or every projectile. Use Gaea for spike floors and V-block puzzles. Switch back to Fourth Armor when a method needs a charged special weapon.

Practice the bike without spending extra entries

Deaths are not a reason to abandon a stage. Continue from the checkpoint, practice the eight-orb line, and use the bike’s air dash across long gaps. Returning to the map just to retry spends another hour.

Dark Hold for the instant-death lasers

In Zero Space 1, activate Dark Hold before entering a laser lane. Keep moving, watch its energy, and bring the Weapon Tank to extend the freeze. Do not wait for a beam to touch you.

Dynamo & Zero Space

Stage / eventBossUse / do
After boss 2; after boss 6 if still requiredDynamoFirst: charged Buster / saber after his returning blade. Second: Wing Spiral / W-Shredder; avoid the marked floor blasts.
Zero Space 1Shadow DevilTri-Thunder / E-Blade against the exposed eye. Jump the low traveling body pieces and wait through invulnerable assembly.
Zero Space 2Rangda Bangda IIDodge between eye attacks. When the walls close, climb clear of the floor spikes and attack the moving nose. Charged Buster or saber works without juggling weaknesses.
Zero Space 3Zero / Awakened Zero, or XGet the secret armor first. X: charged Buster or Nova Strike on openings. Zero: saber or Quake Blazer against X; dodge his copied X4 weapons.
Final stageEight Maverick rematchesReuse the weapon chain. Grizzly can now be hit with Spike Ball. Pick up refill items between fights.
Final stageSigma → final bodyTri-Thunder / E-Blade on the first body. Final: charged Buster or Spike Ball / Twin Dream. Use the hands to reach the head; move before the purple blocks form around you.

Enter the final stage with developed parts equipped and tanks filled. Save before it if you want to revisit the other playable character’s ending.

startHereHtml:
First time playing X5?

What to know before the route

X5 adds a countdown, two hunters and armor programs. Start the opening as X for the Fourth Armor. Collect hearts as X unless you deliberately want to increase Zero’s health instead.

Falcon and Gaea each need all four programs before they can be equipped. A single capsule does not improve the armor you are wearing. Stage entries use time, so group return pickups and save before major decisions.

Fourth Armor
An early suit with air movement and charged special weapons. The opening character choice matters.
Falcon Armor
Flies after a second Jump input in midair. It cannot charge special weapons.
Gaea Armor
Crosses spikes and handles V-blocks, but cannot use special weapons or DNA parts.
DNA parts
Each boss offers a choice of two possible parts. You cannot collect all sixteen in one save.

The colony mission can permanently remove Zero. Read the red warning and DNA plan before advancing the clock. Armor programs and tanks are shared; hearts improve their collector.
